tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List SynergyBoat services as shown on synergyboat.com: id, name, and outcome summary for each. Use get_service for full details.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get one SynergyBoat service in full, by id from list_services.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: List SynergyBoat case studies: slug, title, client, industry, and outcome summary. Use get_case_study for one in full.

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.description: Get one SynergyBoat case study by slug from list_case_studies.

tools.name: list_ai_use_cases
tools.description: List SynergyBoat AI capabilities and use cases as shown on the AI hub: slug, title, category, and overview.

tools.name: list_team
tools.description: List the SynergyBoat team as shown on synergyboat.com/team: name, title, whether the person is leadership, expertise, and public profile links.

tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Get a factual overview of SynergyBoat: what the company does, founders, contact channels, service areas, and verified client rating.

tools.name: submit_lead
tools.description: Submit a contact enquiry to SynergyBoat (name, email, enquiry, consent; optional company). Creates a lead the team follows up on. Requires explicit user consent.

tools.name: request_demo
tools.description: Request a SynergyBoat demo (name, email, consent; optional company, context, and AI use case of interest). Creates a lead the team follows up on. Requires explicit user consent.
